episodes.title: Le journal du matin, mercredi 25 novembre
episodes.headline_en: Edouard Philippe, the Horizons candidate for the presidency, proposes a televised debate to David Lisnard, the mayor of Cannes, before mid-December, franceinfo and Le Monde report
summary_en: Edouard Philippe, the Horizons candidate for the presidency, proposes a televised debate to David Lisnard, the mayor of Cannes, before mid-December, franceinfo and Le Monde report
In the United States, Donald Trump's backing for Jensen Huang's return to the head of the chipmaker Nvidia prompts indignant reactions in Congress, Le Figaro writes

On the international day against violence towards women, the Fondation des femmes publishes a report putting a figure on the cost of leaving the home for a victim of domestic violence, franceinfo and RFI write

episodes.title: Le sport, mercredi 25 novembre
episodes.headline_en: Paris Saint-Germain host AS Roma on Wednesday evening at 9 pm in the Champions League, L'Equipe and Ouest-France write; L'Equipe and franceinfo write PSG are without Kvaratskhelia and Doue
summary_en: Paris Saint-Germain host AS Roma on Wednesday evening at 9 pm in the Champions League, L'Equipe and Ouest-France write; L'Equipe and franceinfo write PSG are without Kvaratskhelia and Doue
Lille host Bayern Munich on Wednesday evening in the Champions League, franceinfo writes; L'Equipe puts kick-off at 9 pm; franceinfo says Bayern are without Harry Kane and Michael Olise

episodes.title: La météo, mercredi 25 novembre
episodes.headline_en: Marseille today: heavy rain, 10 to 16 degrees, wind up to 26 km/h, per the Météo-France models
summary_en: Marseille today: heavy rain, 10 to 16 degrees, wind up to 26 km/h, per the Météo-France models
